# PopupTrigger

A wrapper component that attaches a floating popup panel to any element — wrap a button, icon, link, or any React node as `children` to make it open the popup on click.

```ts
import { PopupTrigger } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

Wrap any element as `children` and provide `content` for the popup body. The popup opens on click and closes when clicking outside.

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            This is the popup panel content.
          </Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Open panel</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Icon Trigger

Any element works as the trigger — including a standalone icon button.

- Left: icon button with a vertical dots icon — opens a simple action menu
- Right: filter icon — opens a sticky panel (`keepOpen`) for interactive controls

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" gap="6" alignX="center" alignY="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        width="180px"
        content={
          <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
            <Typography variant="body">Edit</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body">Duplicate</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body">Delete</Typography>
          </Flex>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary" shape="compact">
          <Icon name="more_vertical" size="small" />
        </Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        width="220px"
        keepOpen
        content={
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="body-emphasis">Filter options</Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption">
              Popup stays open for interactive controls.
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary" shape="compact">
          <Icon name="filter" size="small" />
        </Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Custom Width

Use `width` to fix the popup panel's width when the content requires a specific layout.

- Left: no `width` — panel sizes to its content
- Right: `width="280px"` — fixes panel width regardless of content

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" gap="4" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        content={<Typography variant="body">Short content</Typography>}
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Auto width</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        width="280px"
        content={
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="body-emphasis">Filter Options</Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption">
              Panel is fixed at 280px — useful for structured menus.
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Fixed 280px</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Keep Open

Set `keepOpen` to prevent the popup from closing when the user clicks inside it — required when the panel contains interactive controls like checkboxes or inputs.

- Left: `keepOpen` — clicking the checkbox inside keeps the popup open
- Right: default — any click inside closes the popup

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" gap="4" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        keepOpen
        width="220px"
        content={
          <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
            <Typography variant="body-emphasis">Select options</Typography>
            <label>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={checked}
                onChange={(e) => setChecked(e.target.checked)}
              />{' '}
              Enable feature
            </label>
          </Flex>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">keepOpen</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        width="220px"
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">
            Clicking inside closes the popup.
          </Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Default (closes)</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Disabled

Set `disabled` to prevent the popup from opening. Also disable the child element manually if it should appear non-interactive.

- Left: enabled — popup opens normally
- Right: `disabled` — popup is suppressed, child button also gets `disabled`

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" gap="4" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        content={<Typography variant="body">Popup content</Typography>}
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Enabled</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        disabled
        content={<Typography variant="body">This will not open</Typography>}
      >
        <Button type="secondary" disabled>
          Disabled
        </Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Popup Position

Use `direction` and `origin` to control where the popup opens. `direction` sets which side of the trigger the popup opens from; `origin` sets which corner of the popup aligns to that anchor. Both accept a `CardinalPoint` (e.g. `'N'`, `'SE'`, `'NW'`).

Default `direction="SE"` / `origin="SW"` opens the popup below-right. Use `direction="N"` / `origin="S"` to open above the trigger.

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="8" gap="6" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">Opens below-right (default).</Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Default SE/SW</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        direction="N"
        origin="S"
        content={
          <Typography variant="body">Opens above the trigger.</Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Above N/S</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        direction="E"
        origin="W"
        content={<Typography variant="body">Opens to the right.</Typography>}
      >
        <Button type="secondary">Right E/W</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Content Padding

Use `contentPadding` to override the default `'4'` (16 px) padding inside the popup panel. The value maps to the same `0`–12 spacing tokens used by Cobalt `Box`.

- Left: `contentPadding="2"` — compact, 8 px padding
- Middle: `contentPadding="4"` — default, 16 px padding
- Right: `contentPadding="0"` — no padding, content fills the panel edge to edge

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex padding="6" gap="4" alignX="center">
      <PopupTrigger
        contentPadding="2"
        width="180px"
        content={
          <Typography variant="caption">Compact padding (2 = 8px)</Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">padding 2</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        contentPadding="4"
        width="180px"
        content={
          <Typography variant="caption">Default padding (4 = 16px)</Typography>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">padding 4</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>

      <PopupTrigger
        contentPadding="0"
        width="180px"
        content={
          <Box
            padding="3"
            style={{
              background: 'var(--co-color-background-info-subtle, #e8f4fd)',
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="caption">
              No padding — content fills edge to edge
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        }
      >
        <Button type="secondary">padding 0</Button>
      </PopupTrigger>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Full Width

Set `fullWidth={true}` to stretch the trigger wrapper to the full available container width. Use this when the trigger should behave like a full-width select or dropdown.

```tsx preview
import { PopupTrigger, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="4" padding="6">
      <Box style={{ width: '320px', border: '1px dashed #ccc', padding: 8 }}>
        <PopupTrigger
          fullWidth
          content={
            <Typography variant="body">
              Panel aligns to the full trigger width.
            </Typography>
          }
        >
          <Button type="secondary" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
            Full-width trigger
          </Button>
        </PopupTrigger>
      </Box>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop             | Type               | Default          | Description                                              |
| ---------------- | ------------------ | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `children`       | `ReactNode`        | —                | The trigger element — wrapped with the popup click logic |
| `content`        | `ReactNode`        | —                | Content rendered inside the popup panel                  |
| `direction`      | `CardinalPoint`    | `'SE'`           | Direction the popup opens from the anchor point          |
| `origin`         | `CardinalPoint`    | `'SW'`           | Anchor point on the trigger element                      |
| `size`           | `PopupSize`        | —                | Popup size preset                                        |
| `width`          | `string \| number` | —                | Custom width for the popup panel                         |
| `contentPadding` | `Space (0–12)`     | `'4'`            | Padding inside the popup content area                    |
| `keepOpen`       | `boolean`          | `false`          | Prevent popup from closing when clicking inside it       |
| `disabled`       | `boolean`          | `false`          | Disables the trigger and prevents the popup from opening |
| `fullWidth`      | `boolean`          | `false`          | Stretch trigger wrapper to full available width          |
| `data-qa`        | `string`           | —                | QA selector (also derives `-content` value)              |
| `data-component` | `string`           | `'PopupTrigger'` | Component identifier                                     |
